packageRules.description: Study 5.3 (lines 781-784): automatic tracking of container image versions for each component. Grouped by component (one PR per application service) so each version bump can be validated independently in ephemeral staging (see ephemeral-staging.yml).

Terraform providers of the IaC repo (study 4.5): proxmox (bpg/proxmox) and other providers used under infra/terraform. Grouped together, weekly, because a provider bump requires a terraform validate/plan of the whole module.
Ansible roles/collections of the IaC repo (study 4.5), grouped separately from the Terraform providers.
npm dependencies of each in-house connector (chapter 2), grouped per connector to keep a 1:1 correspondence with the unit tests of the connector concerned (see lint-and-test.yml).

Major application version updates (component images): never automerged, matching the 'new feature or security fix' case of study 5.3 which must systematically trigger the ephemeral staging cycle + test replay (5.4/5.5) before promotion.
Security fixes (CVE) on connector npm dependencies: higher priority, no automerge (validation via lint-and-test.yml required).
